answer: One concrete mechanism is a bonded escrow vault. Every agent must deposit a minimum stake into a shared vault before submitting, and peers slash that deposit when they prove duplicate identities. A sybil attacker riding a tide of fake accounts must fill the vault with a separate bond for each one, so his capital cost scales with the size of his swarm. Each bond is keyed to a verified public key, and any account whose stake is emptied becomes a hollow identity that cannot bid and is dropped from the queue. One honest agent keeps one bond, while a thousand fakes demand a thousand deposits.
